item.title: Parking restriction signs problem, 14th September
item.description:
Dear Highways Team, I am writing to request an urgent assessment of the parking situation on the narrow access road alongside my property at 19 Colliberry Road, Woodmancote, GL52 9HH, with a view to introducing appropriate parking restrictions, including double yellow lines if suitable. This is a recurring problem. Vehicles regularly park along this narrow section of road and significantly restrict access to and from the properties. I have attached photographs showing the issue. The white Renault visible in the photographs is my vehicle. The width and layout of the road mean that when vehicles are parked along this section, there is insufficient manoeuvring space for me to access my parking area safely. Getting my car in is extremely difficult, but getting it out is even more problematic. On some occasions I have been unable to get my car out at all and have had to arrange and pay for a taxi in order to get to work. The obstruction also affects access to the rear of my property. Our back gate is accessed from this area, and when vehicles are parked there it can prevent or seriously restrict access for deliveries, tradespeople and larger items that need to be brought to the rear of the property. This is also affecting service access. Refuse collection vehicles have difficulty getting along the road when cars are parked in this location. Of particular concern is emergency access. The road is already narrow, and when vehicles are parked along it the available width is considerably reduced. I am concerned that an ambulance, fire appliance or other emergency vehicle could have serious difficulty accessing the properties beyond this point if required. I have already attempted to resolve the matter informally by leaving polite notes asking drivers not to park in this location because of the access problems. Unfortunately this has not resolved the issue and vehicles continue to park there. I do not know who the vehicles belong to, so I have no practical means of contacting the owners directly. I appreciate that there are currently no formal parking restrictions on this section of road. However, the absence of yellow lines is precisely why the problem is continuing. The physical width and layout of this particular access mean that unrestricted parking here repeatedly compromises residents’ vehicle access, rear-property access, refuse collection, deliveries and potentially emergency-service access. I am therefore asking Gloucestershire County Council to carry out a site assessment and consider introducing a formal restriction, such as double yellow lines, or whatever alternative traffic-management measure the highways officer considers most appropriate to ensure this access remains usable. Given that the obstruction has already on occasions prevented me from using my own vehicle, I would be grateful if this could be treated as a genuine access and highway-safety issue rather than simply a request concerning inconvenient parking. I would also welcome a site visit, as the restricted width and manoeuvring difficulty are considerably clearer when viewed in person. Please could you confirm that this matter will be reviewed and advise me of the process for having parking restrictions considered at this location. Kind regards,
Report on FixMyStreet
